title: Server-side siteverify: POST to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify with the elicited secret; success:true proceeds, failure rejects 400
description: The applying project verifies every Turnstile response token server-side by POSTing {secret: TURNSTILE_SECRET, response: token} to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify. On success:true the handler proceeds; on success:false the handler rejects with 400 and the refusal body carries the documented error-codes value, not the sitekey or the secret.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-turnstile.
